summary: Two episodes in, the comment section had already turned into a booking board. More than half the thread is named guest requests — Nicky Nachat above all, plus Lee Thanat, Mario, The Toys and a list of 9x9 members — with upvote calls attached. One commenter offers a trade: book Nicky and he will not complain about a single advert and will actively support the sponsor. Another speculates that the show is not ready for Nicky yet because the hosts would lose control of the car, which is exactly what happened when he did appear two episodes later. The rest is concept praise — viewers say the flirting format makes them blush watching it — and a cluster naming Dream as the best thing in the show.

audience_signals: The comment section functions as a booking backlog from episode two onward, and acting on it is provably effective — the most-requested guest here appeared in episode 4, which became the channel's most-viewed talk episode
A viewer explicitly offers ad tolerance in exchange for a specific booking, which is a direct willingness-to-accept-sponsorship signal from the audience
The product is secondhand embarrassment — viewers report blushing while watching, so casting for reactivity matters more than interview craft
Boy-band and ensemble fandoms request their groups as sets, giving the channel multi-episode arcs from a single booking relationship
content_requests: Book Lee Thanat, Mario and The Toys
Work through the 9x9 members as a series
